This small plot of beans is mine, and I plant it every year like my mother showed me. I have no money for the fertilizer bag this season — one bag is too much for this little plot anyway, and the price is high. I keep the seeds from last year's harvest, the same ones that always grow here, and I put them between my millet like always. The rains come when they come, and I will weed with my own hands and my daughter's help.
